name: scoped staff insert work order documents
assigned contractor and scoped managers read dispatch
assigned contractor and scoped managers read submissions
assigned contractor submits invoice and job card
check:
((uploaded_by = lower(( SELECT (auth.jwt() ->> 'email'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM work_order_dispatches d
  WHERE ((d.id = work_order_submissions.dispatch_id) AND (d.recipient_email = work_order_submissions.uploaded_by) AND private.can_access_work_order_dispatch(d.id)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM storage.objects o
  WHERE ((o.bucket_id = 'work-order-documents'::text) AND (o.name = work_order_submissions.job_card_path)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM storage.objects o
  WHERE ((o.bucket_id = 'work-order-documents'::text) AND (o.name = work_order_submissions.invoice_path)))))

name: work order document readers
qual:
((bucket_id = 'work-order-documents'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text) THEN private.can_access_work_order_dispatch((split_part(name, '/'::text, 1))::bigint)
    ELSE false
END)

name: contractor uploads work order documents
check:
((bucket_id = 'work-order-documents'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (split_part(name, '/'::text, 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text) THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM work_order_dispatches d
      WHERE ((d.id = (split_part(objects.name, '/'::text, 1))::bigint) AND (d.recipient_email = lower(( SELECT (auth.jwt() ->> 'email'::text)))) AND private.can_access_work_order_dispatch(d.id))))
    ELSE false
END)

name: scoped managers read client invoice audit
qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM client_invoices i
  WHERE ((i.id = client_invoice_events.invoice_id) AND private.client_invoice_can_manage(i.block_id))))
